title: docs(readme): remove the StackBlitz quick-start row
body:
Closes #32553

## What

Removes the README quick-start table row `Look first, install nothing` (the StackBlitz link to the hotcrm example).

## Why

Maintainer ruling on #32553: StackBlitz is unreliable (slow, error-prone), so the link goes. The website already dropped its StackBlitz CTA under the same ruling (www.objectos.ai #409).

## Scope

- One line deleted from `README.md`. The T1-T4 positioning lines (README 7-14, 27-31) are untouched.
- `git grep -n -i stackblitz -- README.md content/docs` now prints nothing.
- Root README is not a published package file and nothing publishes from this diff, so no changeset (`skip-changeset` label applies).
